feature: Run a new native backtest from an owned verified archive and retain an exact comparison

comparison.comparison: Exact equality of every native trade field (including orders/fees/funding), list order and selected summary metrics; no rounding or tolerance.
comparison.note: Dùng mã, tham số, nến/mark/funding và cấu hình trong gói. Metadata thị trường Binance vẫn được engine lấy qua mạng; gói cũ chưa ghim phần này nên không bảo đảm kết quả khớp. Không sửa thư viện, tải thêm nến hoặc đổi paper.

real_run.source_and_replay_inputs: copied from archive, never from current library

tests.nonfinite_trade_values: comparison unavailable, never normalized to matching null

limitations: Binance market metadata remains external and is not frozen in old packages. Exact match is evidence on this sample only.
No assertion of profitability or real exchange fill accuracy.
No archive import or database-seeding replay is implemented; reruns use existing owned packages.
